title: Today's English Review
source_summary: Present perfect, travel vocabulary, and polite requests

questions.explanation_en: Use the past simple with a finished time such as yesterday.
questions.explanation_zh: 和 yesterday 这类已结束时间连用时，使用一般过去时。

questions.explanation_en: The present perfect uses have plus a past participle.
questions.explanation_zh: 现在完成时由 have 加过去分词构成。

questions.prompt: Ask someone politely to open the window.
questions.explanation_en: Could you and would you are both polite request forms.
questions.explanation_zh: Could you 和 would you 都可以构成礼貌请求。

questions.prompt: Where do you collect a checked suitcase after a flight?
questions.explanation_en: Baggage claim is the area where arriving passengers collect luggage.
questions.explanation_zh: Baggage claim 是抵达旅客领取托运行李的区域。

questions.prompt: She has ___ to London, so she is not here now.
questions.explanation_en: Gone is the past participle of go and means she is still away.
questions.explanation_zh: Gone 是 go 的过去分词，并表示她现在仍未回来。
